description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2112/32 that published Orders on Meritorious Service Medal and Service Medal
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to regulations governing the Meritorious Service Medal (Sevabhimani Padakkama), including eligibility criteria, design specifications, registration requirements, and forfeiture conditions. It constitutes legal/regulatory matter as it modifies existing statutory instruments and establishes formal rules for medal awards, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
